## Who we are
DN Car Covers is a Bangalore-based seller of premium vehicle covers serving Bangalore and all over Karnataka. Tagline: Zero compromise. Contact is by WhatsApp: +91 81478 86006 (https://wa.me/918147886006). Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/premium_z_covers/

## What we sell
There is one Premium cover (no lower tier). Every cover is waterproof, UV protected and dust proof.
1. Premium car cover: ₹2,999. https://dncarcover.in/car-cover
   Wheel-to-roof fit covering tyres and bumper. Multi-layer waterproof shell with soft paint-safe lining. Hot-taped seams. Mirror pockets, door zip, reflective strips.
2. Premium bike and scooter cover: ₹1,499. https://dncarcover.in/bike-cover
   Ground-length skirt over wheels and tyres. Hydrophobic shell, hot-taped seams, cotton lining. Windproof lock buckle. Scooters and electric scooters use the same cover.
3. Custom fit car covers by model: ₹2,999 (Brezza and Triber ₹3,499). https://dncarcover.in/car-covers/
   Brezza and Triber ₹3,499; WagonR, Duster, Ertiga, Maruti 800, Urban Cruiser, XUV 500, Punch, Hyryder ₹2,999. Other cars quoted on request.
4. Custom sizes for other vehicles or items: message on WhatsApp for a quote.

## How to order
1. Pick your vehicle on the site or message it on WhatsApp.
2. We confirm the exact fit for your make and model.
3. We confirm payment and delivery on WhatsApp.
